usedFor: Avaza holds invoices, and Google Docs gets a record from “Invoice created” via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Invoice created” in Avaza, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new invoice can write its details into a selected tab, so the doc keeps up without copying by hand.

watchOut: Because “Invoice updated” also fires, choose add or replace on purpose, or one invoice can overwrite its own tab content.
